M11 — 2026-09-21 — replaced by rust-core M18
sofar_update_plan (plan_updated) rebuilds the phase objects, so every phase NOTE set by an earlier phase_status_changed is silently dropped. The fold warns only about task and phase STATUSES, and the plan schema has no field to restate a note. After any plan replacement, re-issue sofar_update_phase with the same status and note for each phase that had one. To write to a record that lives on another worktree's branch (e.g. rust-core in ~/IO/sofar-rust-core) from a session whose MCP server is bound to main, spawn `sofar mcp` with cwd set to that worktree and call the tools over stdio JSON-RPC (initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/call). A plan_updated from main's stale copy would clobber the branch plan on union. Event-only writes (notes, memories, session events) can instead go through main and be carried over with `sofar export <slug>` | `sofar import - <slug> --root <worktree>`, which dedupes by id.
